# Spine Web Player

The unmodified files in `4.2.120/` are from Esoteric Software's official
`@esotericsoftware/spine-player` npm package, pinned to version **4.2.120**.
They support skeleton exports from Spine **4.2.x**, not other major/minor versions.
The ES module is self-contained; there are no runtime CDN dependencies.

Source: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/@esotericsoftware/spine-player/v/4.2.120>

Documentation: <https://esotericsoftware.com/spine-player>

Files downloaded without modification from
`https://unpkg.com/@esotericsoftware/spine-player@4.2.120/`:

The complete upstream [Spine Runtimes License Agreement](4.2.120/LICENSE) and
copyright notice must stay with redistribution. The project owner confirmed
they hold a Spine license for this site's integration. This runtime license is
independent from the rights and fan-content terms for Blue Archive assets.

The site uses its own translated playback controls (`showControls: false`), so
the bundled upstream CSS is retained for provenance but is not loaded globally.
`scripts/spine-viewer.js` is Project Archive's separate integration code.
